incidents.name: UPS transfers to pair do not change pair balance
incidents.notes: UPS's _transfer leaves the UPS/USDT pair's UPS balance unchanged when tokens are sent to it, so the attacker repeatedly swapped, skimmed and synced to pull the pair's USDT out.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x3dA4828640aD831F3301A4597821Cc3461B06678 created 2024-04-08T07:08:42Z by 0x51c81533b28534ff5f63c57efeebd5cce5b87e8c, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xc4c306c20b4a22f1d261f11c40e88603dd2a2888; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
